evidence_quotes.quote: Global Development and Human (In)Security: understanding the rise of the Rajah Solaiman Movement and Balik Islam in the Philippines
Using social movement theory to frame our analytical narrative, we investigate how the demands and pressures of globalisation have helped to foment 'Balik Islam'
